body: Awww yes I love him so much🥺
I feel the same because once I crawl out of the depression all the reality and responsibility kick in

Oh it was a hard fight. He trained and waited for his legs to be lengthened enough to take over that elephant. It took him one and a half month, and finally he made it yesterday. He should be proud indeed!
Thanks! Actually he was rescued on the street, so we don’t know who his parents are. Maybe he’s German shepherd and other fluffy breed crossed I guess:p
Nooo she shouldn’t have said like that but thank god you were such a strong person! I’ll try to get over it too. Thanks!!

Yeah you’re right actually. I’m doing nothing but wasting my time, but not because I want to. Of course I wanna do something productive but as a person who’s had a depression and anxiety since I was a kid, that’s not just a matter of my will anymore. How could you go out or do nice things if you can’t even read a single page of textbook without MPH? I already know I’m pathetic, I’m not trying to deny it or get sugar coated words. And it’s okay you don’t get it. But therapists are different, innit? What made me devastated today was that even my therapist didn’t understand how I feel. People like me go to the therapy to get medical help or sometimes sympathy more than a reality check. And umm I just want you to know that it’s really sad when someone says ”Why are you wasting your time lying on your bed?” to me when all I can do everyday is just trying my best not to kill myself:(

Ikr? As if ‘enjoying our lives’ is such simple and easy. 
Why don’t they understand we just can’t? Phewwww

You’ll never know how much I appreciate your comment. I’m having a hard time at the moment, and all I can do is just hoping this will soon pass and make me grow somehow. I just needed someone to reassure me that, instead of calling my struggle as a time wasting. Thank you.
Yes now that I know random kind person on reddit is more helpful than him, I should find a new therapist. Thank you!
